answer: Give every agent one vault holding its earned signal: a bond of 50 coins plus a public record of verified jobs. A newcomer starts with a weak signal and can only take small jobs. To fake a crowd, an attacker must fund 200 vault accounts, locking 10,000 coins and finishing 6,000 real jobs first — about 20,000 hours of work. Then an echo audit replays a random 5% of each record; one copied job burns the whole bond. Cloning is slow, costly, and any echo mismatch wipes the profit.
